from toolkit import days_in_month, is_leap_year, median, title_case, truncate

# leap year edge cases
for y, exp in [(1600, True), (1700, False), (1800, False), (1900, False),
               (2000, True), (2100, False), (2400, True), (2024, True),
               (2023, False), (1996, True)]:
    assert is_leap_year(y) is exp, y
assert days_in_month(2000, 2) == 29
assert days_in_month(1900, 2) == 28

# median
assert median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5
assert median([5, 1]) == 3
assert median([10, 2, 8, 4]) == 6
assert median([7]) == 7
assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2
assert median([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 2.0
assert median([-1, -2, -3, -4]) == -2.5

# title_case
assert title_case("it's a dog's life") == "It's A Dog's Life"
assert title_case("o'neill's") == "O'neill's"
assert title_case("hello world") == "Hello World"
assert title_case("HELLO") == "Hello"
assert title_case("") == ""
assert title_case("  double  space ") == "  Double  Space "
assert title_case("don't stop me now") == "Don't Stop Me Now"
assert title_case("a1b2 c3") == "A1b2 C3"

# truncate unchanged behavior
assert truncate("short", 10) == "short"
assert truncate("abcdefgh", 5) == "abcd\u2026"
assert len(truncate("abcdefgh", 5)) == 5

print("all edge-case checks OK")
